description: WPF surface: two new keyed theme styles, the HomeView and ServicesListView UserControls, the OperatorWindow host hosts (HomePanel/ServicesListPanel + sidebar empty-state), and all host plumbing/event wiring that turns Home into the landing screen and the Services tab into the services-list table with open/create/rename/delete. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (consumes ServiceFileInfo, ServiceListRow, ServiceListingBuilder, ListServiceFilesAsync, GetFilePathFor). Implements design.md items 6, 7, 8, 9, 10a, 10a-bis, 10b, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15. CRASH-AVOIDANCE IS LOAD-BEARING: OperatorWindow.xaml must stay resource-dictionary-free (inline brushes only, NO {StaticResource}); the two UserControls merge OwcDesignSystem.xaml and may use ONLY the verified *Brush keys; ComboBox uses OwcDarkComboBox; no implicit/keyless styles.
steps: Edit WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml: add two KEYED styles using only verified *Brush keys. OwcDarkListView (TargetType ListView: Background=Transparent, Foreground={StaticResource OwcTextPrimaryBrush}, BorderThickness=0, ItemContainerStyle = a keyed OwcDarkListViewItem whose ControlTemplate paints a dark row and sets Background={StaticResource OwcSurfaceHoverBrush} on IsMouseOver and IsSelected). OwcDarkGridViewColumnHeader (TargetType GridViewColumnHeader: Background={StaticResource OwcPanelBrush}, Foreground={StaticResource OwcTextSecondaryBrush}, HorizontalContentAlignment=Left, thin bottom border via OwcBorderBrush). All keyed, never implicit. Do NOT modify OwcDarkComboBox or any ComboBox style.

Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/Home/HomeView.xaml + HomeView.xaml.cs (UserControl). Merge OwcDesignSystem.xaml inside <UserControl.Resources> via <ResourceDictionary><ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries><ResourceDictionary Source="pack://application:,,,/WorshipPlayer.Presenter;component/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml"/></...></...> exactly like ServiceInfoDialog.xaml. Layout (design item 6): Quick start card (Border Style={StaticResource OwcPanelBorder}) with 6 square Buttons Style={StaticResource OwcButtonBase} labelled Tour, Services, Songs, Slides, Media, Scripture (glyph + text); Upcoming services card (OwcPanelBorder) with a ListView Style={StaticResource OwcDarkListView} + GridView columns Date|Type|Title (GridViewColumnHeader Style={StaticResource OwcDarkGridViewColumnHeader}, cell TextBlocks TextTrimming=CharacterEllipsis) plus a trailing column with a '⋮' Button whose ContextMenu has Open/Rename/Delete; a centered Button Style={StaticResource OwcAccentButton} '+ Add a new service'. Code-behind: public events TourRequested, ServicesRequested, SongsRequested, SlidesRequested, MediaRequested, ScriptureRequested, AddServiceRequested, OpenServiceRequested(string), RenameServiceRequested(string), DeleteServiceRequested(string); public void SetServices(IEnumerable<ServiceListRow> rows) binding the ListView ItemsSource. Overflow menu items resolve the row's FilePath and raise the matching event.

Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/ServiceBuilder/ServicesListView.xaml + ServicesListView.xaml.cs (UserControl, same theme merge). Layout (design item 7): top bar with a Filters ComboBox Style={StaticResource OwcDarkComboBox} (single placeholder item 'All'), a Search TextBox Style={StaticResource OwcTextBox}, and a right-aligned Button Style={StaticResource OwcAccentButton} '+ New Service'; main ListView Style={StaticResource OwcDarkListView} + GridView columns Date|Type|Title|Last modified|Last modified by plus trailing '⋮' overflow column (Open/Rename/Delete). Row click (SelectionChanged or item MouseLeftButtonUp) raises OpenServiceRequested(filePath). Code-behind: public events NewServiceRequested, OpenServiceRequested(string), RenameServiceRequested(string), DeleteServiceRequested(string); public void SetServices(IEnumerable<ServiceListRow>) stores the full list in a private field and binds it; Search TextChanged calls ServiceListingBuilder.Filter(fullList, text) and rebinds.

Edit WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml (INLINE BRUSHES ONLY, NO {StaticResource}): in the Row-3/Column-1 content Grid (Row 1), add two sibling Visibility-toggled hosts next to ServicesPanel: <Border x:Name="HomePanel" Background="#0F1117"><ContentPresenter x:Name="HomePanelContent"/></Border> with Visibility=Visible, and <Border x:Name="ServicesListPanel" Visibility="Collapsed" Background="#0F1117"><ContentPresenter x:Name="ServicesListPanelContent"/></Border>; change ServicesPanel to Visibility="Collapsed" initially. In the sidebar Grid Row 1, overlay a SidebarEmptyState element: a Rectangle Stroke="#2A2E3A" StrokeDashArray="4 3" behind a TextBlock (Foreground="#8B92A5", TextWrapping=Wrap) with exact text 'To begin, select a service from the Services list. Your service items will appear here.'; HorizontalAlignment=Stretch with margins, NO fixed pixel width.

Edit WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml.cs plumbing: (a) change SaveServiceOrderAsync() to SaveServiceOrderAsync(string? path = null) forwarding path into _serviceOrderManager.SaveAsync(path). (b) change LoadServiceOrderAsync(string path) return type to Task<bool>: return (loaded != null) after LoadAsync, return false in catch. (c) add private static bool SamePath(string? a, string? b) => a!=null && b!=null && string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(a), Path.GetFullPath(b), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase). (d) add fields HomeView? _homeView; ServicesListView? _servicesListView; string? _currentServicePath; and tab-name constants if used. (e) at the END of the full Initialize(...) void: lazily new HomeView, wire all its events to the handlers from the next step, set HomePanelContent.Content=_homeView, HomePanel.Visibility=Visible, ServicesPanel.Visibility=Collapsed, keep the existing RefreshServiceOrderList(), then _ = RefreshServiceListingInitialAsync(); where RefreshServiceListingInitialAsync is a private async Task that try/catches await RefreshServiceListingAsync() -> ShowToolError. (f) add private async Task RefreshServiceListingAsync(): var files = await _serviceOrderManager.ListServiceFilesAsync(); var rows = ServiceListingBuilder.Build(files, DateTime.UtcNow); _homeView?.SetServices(rows); _servicesListView?.SetServices(rows); all wrapped in try/catch -> ShowToolError. (g) repoint the Services tab: add async void ShowServicesList() (and point TabServices_Click at it) that lazily news+wires _servicesListView, sets ServicesListPanelContent.Content, shows ServicesListPanel, hides the other panels, SetTabActive(TabServices), await RefreshServiceListingAsync(); extend SwitchToTab's hide-all block to also collapse HomePanel and ServicesListPanel. (h) add private void ShowServiceEditor() hiding Home/ServicesList/others and showing ServicesPanel, and when the order is empty/none-current set CurrentItemTitle.Text=CurrentServiceOrder?.Name ?? "" and CurrentItemSubtitle.Text=CurrentServiceOrder?.ServiceType ?? "". (i) in RefreshServiceOrderList, toggle SidebarEmptyState.Visibility (Visible when _serviceOrderItems.Count==0 else Collapsed).

Wire view events in OperatorWindow.xaml.cs (design item 14; all async handlers are async void at the WPF boundary delegating to try/caught helpers). OpenServiceRequested(path): if (await LoadServiceOrderAsync(path)) { _currentServicePath = path; ShowServiceEditor(); RefreshServiceOrderList(); }. AddServiceRequested + NewServiceRequested: a DEDICATED handler (NOT NewService_Click) - new ServiceInfoDialog{Owner=this}; if (dlg.ShowDialog()!=true || !dlg.Confirmed) return; _serviceOrderManager.CreateNew(dlg.ServiceName, dlg.ServiceDate); _serviceOrderManager.CurrentServiceOrder!.StartTime = dlg.StartTime; await SaveServiceOrderAsync(); _currentServicePath = _serviceOrderManager.GetFilePathFor(_serviceOrderManager.CurrentServiceOrder!); RefreshServiceOrderList(); await RefreshServiceListingAsync(); -- never open AddServiceItemDialog, never ShowServiceEditor(). RenameServiceRequested(path): guard if(!SamePath(path,_currentServicePath) || _serviceOrderManager.CurrentServiceOrder==null) return; var order=CurrentServiceOrder; var dlg=new ServiceInfoDialog{Owner=this}; dlg.Initialize(order.Name, order.Date, order.StartTime); if(dlg.ShowDialog()!=true||!dlg.Confirmed) return; order.Name=dlg.ServiceName; order.Date=dlg.ServiceDate; order.StartTime=dlg.StartTime; await SaveServiceOrderAsync(path); RefreshServiceOrderList(); await RefreshServiceListingAsync(); -- NEVER call LoadAsync. The views enable Rename only on the row where SamePath(row.FilePath,_currentServicePath). DeleteServiceRequested(path): MessageBox Yes/No default No; on Yes try File.Delete(path) catch -> ShowToolError('Delete Service', ex.Message); await RefreshServiceListingAsync(); if(SamePath(path,_currentServicePath)) _currentServicePath=null. Quick-start routers: ServicesRequested->ShowServicesList(); SongsRequested->SwitchToTab('Songs'); ScriptureRequested->SwitchToTab('Scripture'); MediaRequested->SwitchToTab('Media'); SlidesRequested->ShowServiceEditor(); TourRequested->no-op.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln -c Debug succeeds with 0 errors.
OperatorWindow.xaml contains NO {StaticResource} reference and merges NO ResourceDictionary; the new hosts use inline hex brushes only.
Both new UserControls merge OwcDesignSystem.xaml and reference only the verified *Brush keys and keyed styles; any ComboBox uses OwcDarkComboBox.

dotnet run --project WorshipPlayer.UI opens the OperatorWindow WITHOUT a load-time crash, landing on the Home screen (Quick start + Upcoming services + '+ Add a new service'); the Services tab shows the services table; no white-on-white theming.
verification: dotnet run --project WorshipPlayer.UI  (manual STA smoke: operator window opens on Home with no crash and no white-on-white; Services tab shows the table; then close the window)
findings:
Done. Solution build 0 errors (4 pre-existing warnings), tests 479 passing, and dotnet run --project WorshipPlayer.UI opened the OperatorWindow on the Home screen with NO load-time crash and clean exit (empty STDERR, no XAML load exceptions).

Implemented (design items 6,7,8,9,10a,10a-bis,10b,10,11,12,13,14,15):
- OwcDesignSystem.xaml: added three KEYED styles only (OwcDarkGridViewColumnHeader, OwcDarkListViewItem, OwcDarkListView) using only verified *Brush keys (OwcPanelBrush/OwcTextSecondaryBrush/OwcBorderBrush/OwcTextPrimaryBrush/OwcSurfaceHoverBrush). OwcDarkListViewItem uses a GridViewRowPresenter ControlTemplate so GridView columns still render; hover+selection paint OwcSurfaceHoverBrush. ComboBox styles untouched.
- Views/Home/HomeView.xaml(.cs): UserControl merging OwcDesignSystem.xaml; Quick start UniformGrid of 6 OwcButtonBase buttons (Tour/Services/Songs/Slides/Media/Scripture) + Upcoming services OwcDarkListView (Date|Type|Title + overflow) + centered OwcAccentButton '+ Add a new service'. Typed events + SetServices(IEnumerable<ServiceListRow>).
- Views/ServiceBuilder/ServicesListView.xaml(.cs): UserControl; Filters OwcDarkComboBox ('All') + Search OwcTextBox + right OwcAccentButton '+ New Service'; OwcDarkListView columns Date|Type|Title|Last modified|Last modified by + overflow. Row click (SelectionChanged, then clears selection so re-open works) raises OpenServiceRequested. Search TextChanged filters the stored full list via ServiceListingBuilder.Filter and rebinds.
- OperatorWindow.xaml: added HomePanel (visible) + ServicesListPanel (collapsed) sibling Border+ContentPresenter hosts in the Row-3/Col-1 content Grid; set ServicesPanel initial Visibility=Collapsed; added SidebarEmptyState (Rectangle StrokeDashArray='4 3' + helper TextBlock, HorizontalAlignment=Stretch, no fixed width). INLINE hex brushes only; NO {StaticResource}, NO ResourceDictionary merged.
- OperatorWindow.xaml.cs: SaveServiceOrderAsync -> optional (string? path=null) forwarding to SaveAsync(path); LoadServiceOrderAsync -> Task<bool> (loaded!=null / false in catch); added SamePath helper (fully qualified System.IO.Path to avoid System.Windows.Shapes.Path ambiguity); fields _homeView/_servicesListView/_currentServicePath; Initialize tail hosts Home via EnsureHomeView + fire-and-forget RefreshServiceListingInitialAsync; RefreshServiceListingAsync (null-guarded, builds rows via Core, sets both views); ShowServicesList (repointed TabServices_Click); ShowServiceEditor (writes header for empty/none-current order); SwitchToTab hide-all now collapses HomePanel+ServicesListPanel; RefreshServiceOrderList toggles SidebarEmptyState; dedicated OnNewServiceRequested (CreateNew+StartTime+Save+GetFilePathFor+RefreshServiceOrderList+RefreshServiceListingAsync, never AddServiceItemDialog/ShowServiceEditor), OnOpenServiceRequested (branches on LoadServiceOrderAsync bool), OnRenameServiceRequested (SamePath guard, edits CurrentServiceOrder in place, SaveServiceOrderAsync(path), never LoadAsync), OnDeleteServiceRequested (Yes/No default No, File.Delete try/catch, clears _currentServicePath on SamePath).

Notes: _serviceOrderManager is set in SetServices (called by PresenterIntegration AFTER Initialize), so the initial scan is fired-and-forgotten and RefreshServiceListingAsync is null-guarded; it binds once the manager is wired. No forbidden areas touched (chords/LoadStandaloneSong/F2-F3/ComboBox theme/sidebar click/LoadAllAsync). No new NuGet deps, no csproj edits.
